news.analysis: Williams came into the game with just one interception on the season, but he struggled on Sunday night, throwing four picks in the close win over Tampa Bay. His touchdowns went to Luther Burden III and Rome Odunze in the contest. Williams has thrown for 1,546 yards, eight touchdowns, and five interceptions in six games for the Bears this year. A solid fantasy QB1 for the rest of the season, Williams will be on bye in Week 10 before a Week 11 matchup vs. the Saints.
